raw_response:
This sorghum plot is very small, only a few steps across. I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it — one bag costs too much and it is more than this land needs. I will carry manure from my homestead and spread it with my hands, because that costs no money. I will use the sorghum seed I saved from last year, and my children and I will do all the work ourselves.
